finding: The Loading shell board draws a fully populated inspector while its own footer and canvas say the site is still arriving.
evidence: 65:412 'Shell state 12 · Loading' -> Inspector 65:508 (300x812) whose only child is 65:509 'Inspector — 300 · CONTAINER profile' (300x812), while the same board's footer reads 'Loading…' (65:607) and its canvas holds 65:611 'canvas skeleton' (680x568). Code disagrees: ProInspector.tsx:314-316 returns <InspectorLoading/> when `projectLoading && !selectedElement`, and InspectorLoading.tsx:32-47 renders a header skeleton + 6 skeleton rows — which is exactly what section 08's 159:102 'Inspector · loading' (300x812, Header 159:103 + skeleton 0..5) draws.
fix: Replace 65:509 with an instance of 159:102 so the Loading board shows the skeleton inspector its own footer and canvas already imply.

finding: The no-selection inspector — the shell's default right-hand state — is drawn three different ways across the shell boards and none of the three matches the canonical board or the code.
evidence: 65:2 -> 65:98 Inspector 300x748 holds a loose 32x32 frame (66:2 at x=134 y=333) plus text 66:3 'Select something on the canvas to edit it.' (244x40 at x=28 y=375), no wrapper and no AI link. 199:2 -> 199:201 'no-selection' 300x200 at y=280, text 199:202 268x40 at y=0, no AI link; 2162:11734 and 2162:11912 repeat that 300x200@y=280 block. Canonical 159:99 'Inspector · no-selection' puts 159:100 'Empty state' 300x160 at y=0 with the sentence at y=64 and 920:4717 '✦ Ask AI ›' at y=92. Code follows 159:99: InspectorEmptyState.tsx:127 `CONTAINER = ...tw:pt-16` (=64px, comment '159:99, sentence at y64') and :85-91 renders a `inspector-empty-ask-ai` Button.
fix: Replace 65:98's loose children, 199:201, 2162:11734 and 2162:11912 with instances of 159:99 (Empty state 300x160 anchored at y=0, sentence y=64, ✦ Ask AI y=92).

finding: The ENTRY POINT board is the only shell board that still draws an icon in the inspector empty state, and that icon was deliberately deleted from the design.
evidence: 65:2 -> 65:98 -> 66:2 FRAME 32x32 at x=134 y=333 (horizontally centred in the 300 column). Neither 159:99 nor any other shell board has it, and InspectorEmptyState.tsx:71-81 records the removal in so many words: 'What it replaces was an icon circle, an h3, a description, a two-button CTA stack … and a keyboard tip'.
fix: Delete 66:2 when 65:98 is re-instanced from 159:99.

finding: On the Multi-select board the inspector's batch-style half is drawn OUTSIDE the inspector — parked at the board's left edge on top of the rail and drawer.
evidence: 66:4 -> Inspector 66:100 (300x780) contains only '3 selected' (66:203), ALIGN (66:205, 6 chips) and DISTRIBUTE (66:219, 2 chips), ending at y=212 of 780. The five batch rows and the Mixed note that 159:123 puts INSIDE the inspector (238:1416 Background / 238:1420 Text colour / 238:1424 Radius / 236:1420 Padding / 238:1428 Font size / 159:158 note) exist on 66:4 as a separate board-level child 1709:8394 'Batch style rows' 300x205 at x=0 y=655 — absolute x=0 puts it over the Rail (0-60) and Drawer (60-340) of the same middle band. 66:100 also lacks the `btn/ai` chip 159:123 carries (920:4714).
fix: Move 1709:8394's rows inside 66:100 at x=1140-relative 0, y=164 following 159:123's order, and add the btn/ai chip to the header row.

finding: Section 08's inspector boards are all 300x812, but four shell states draw the inspector shorter than that, so a section-08 board cannot be dropped into them without clipping 32-64px.
evidence: Every full-column board in section 08 '08 · Inspector · 37' is 300x812 (807:8342 TEXT, 807:8412 FLEX, 807:8475 GRID, 807:8521 MEDIA, 807:8567 BUTTON, 807:8614 INPUT, 32:2 CONTAINER, 159:99, 159:102, 159:123, 160:2, 160:105, 160:208, 160:313, 160:412, 160:512, 189:2, 1707:8456). The shell draws it at 300x748 (65:98, 66:736), 300x768 (200:309) and 300x780 (66:100). The WIDTH is consistent everywhere — 300 on every shell board and `--bk-size-inspector: 300px` (tokens.generated.css:131) — the height is not.
fix: Restore the middle band to 812 on 65:2, 66:4 and 66:640 (see SH-E-22) and re-draw 200:213's inspector at the 768 the review bar leaves, or accept 768 as a second declared height and note it on the section-08 boards.

finding: The inspector can be hidden by the user and the choice is remembered, but no shell board draws the shell without an inspector column.
evidence: StudioPanels.tsx:232-241 seeds `inspectorShown` from `localStorage['buildrick-inspector-shown']` and :424 passes `inspectorOpen={!readOnlyView && !effectiveFullPageMode && inspectorShown}`. The door is the canvas toolbar's Inspector toggle, CanvasFooterToolbar.tsx:379-385, whose own comment says 'Inspector is 300 of 1440; hiding it takes the canvas lane from 752 to 1052'. All 13 live shell boards draw the inspector at 300 (65:98, 199:98, 199:301, 66:100, 199:505, 200:98, 200:309, 66:321, 66:537, 66:736, 65:508, 2162:11733, 2162:11911); none draws rail 60 + drawer 280 + canvas 1100, or rail 60 + canvas 1380.
fix: Add a 'Shell state · inspector hidden' board at 1440x900 with Rail 60 + Drawer 280 + Canvas 1100 and the toolbar's Inspector chip inactive, since this is a persisted state a returning user opens into.

finding: The AI drill-in board fills only the top 206px of the 812 inspector column and leaves the remaining 606px undrawn, while the code replaces the whole column.
evidence: 66:225 -> Inspector 66:321 (300x812) has exactly two children: header 66:424 (300x44) and body 66:427 (300x162) — 206px total, no panel background below. StudioPanels.tsx:495-503 swaps the entire inspector for <AITab/> when `aiInInspector` is true (set at :298), so the live column is AI top-to-bottom.
fix: Extend 66:427 (or add a filler/spacer) to reach 812, matching 160:512 'Inspector · ai-agent-run' which is drawn full-height.

finding: Below 1366px the inspector floats over the canvas AND keeps its 300px grid column reserved — the narrow-viewport rule never reaches the class production actually renders, so the shell loses 300px of canvas to an empty track.
evidence: LayoutShell.css:323-339 overrides columns only for `.layout-shell--inspector-open` (specificity 0,1,0) and `.layout-shell--drawer-open.layout-shell--inspector-open`. Production always passes LayoutShell.Sidebar (StudioPanels.tsx:429), so LayoutShell.tsx:275-281 emits `layout-shell--has-sidebar` (:278) and never `--drawer-open` (:280 requires `!slots.sidebar`); the applied column rule is `.layout-shell--has-sidebar.layout-shell--inspector-open` (LayoutShell.css:183-189, specificity 0,2,0) which the media block does not touch. `.layout-shell__inspector` at LayoutShell.css:341-350 does apply — position:absolute, top 56, right 12, bottom 12, width 300. Net at a 1366 viewport: sidebar 340 + canvas 726 + an empty 300 column, with a 300 inspector floating on top of the empty column. Its `top: var(--layout-topbar-height, 56px)` is also wrong here: no LayoutShell.TopBar is passed, so `layout-shell--no-topbar` is on and the shell already starts below the header — the float is pushed a further 56px down. No board draws any of this; the only narrow board, 202:2, is RETIRED and covered the drawer, not the inspector.
fix: Either add `.layout-shell--has-sidebar.layout-shell--inspector-open` to the ≤1366 column override and change `top` to 0, or delete the media block outright now that the sibling drawer-overlay branch was removed (LayoutShell.tsx:267-272). Then board whichever behaviour survives.

finding: The shell ships 64px of bottom chrome where the design says 32: an empty 32px grid footer track plus the real 32px status bar — and every board faithfully draws the dead strip.
evidence: StudioPanels.tsx:411-524 passes only Sidebar, Canvas, Inspector and FullPage to <LayoutShell> — no LayoutShell.Footer — yet `.layout-shell--has-sidebar.layout-shell--no-topbar` reserves `grid-template-rows: 1fr var(--layout-footer-height, 32px)` (LayoutShell.css:174-181). The real footer is a flex sibling of the shell, rendered at AquibraStudio.tsx:710-728 with class `layout-shell__footer` (grid-area inert in the .bd-studio flex host — the file says so at LayoutShell.css:114-115). The boards mirror the dead 32: canvas 812 = tabs 36 + viewport 744 + 32 unused (199:70/199:273/199:477/200:70/66:293/66:509/65:480/2162:11664/963:4524/642:3764); canvas 780 = 36 + 712 + 32 (66:72); canvas 748 = 36 + 680 + 32 (66:708); 748 = 716 + 32 (65:70); preview 844 = 812 + 32 (65:279). Not one canvas region on any board fills its own column.
fix: Drop the footer row from the --no-topbar templates (rows become `1fr`) since nothing is ever placed in it, then grow every board's canvas viewport by 32 to meet the footer.

finding: Every shell board puts the page-tab bar at the TOP of the canvas column; the code renders it at the BOTTOM, on the authority of a different board.
evidence: Boards draw 'Page tabs (canvas column only · >1 page)' at y=0 above the viewport: 199:71 (1080x36 y=0, viewport 199:82 at y=36), and identically 199:274, 199:478, 200:71, 200:282, 66:73, 66:294, 66:510, 66:709, 2162:11665, 2162:11843, 963:4525, 642:3765. Code renders <PageTabBar> AFTER the canvas div inside LayoutShell.Canvas (StudioPanels.tsx:455-488), i.e. last in a flex column, and its comment cites the opposite board: 'Board 435:2348: the tab bar sits at the canvas FOOT — the context menu opens upward from it.'
fix: Settle which board has authority (435:2348 vs the 13 shell boards) and move the losing side. If the foot wins, redraw the tab bar at y=776 on the 812 canvases and re-anchor the viewport to y=0.

finding: The floating canvas toolbar hangs out of the bottom of the canvas region on two boards, including the ENTRY POINT board.
evidence: The toolbar is pinned at y=715 h=40 (bottom 755) on every board regardless of the canvas height it sits in. On 65:2 the canvas 65:70 is 1080x748, so 463:3962 overruns the canvas frame by 7px and the viewport 65:82 (716) by 39px. On 66:640 the canvas 66:708 is 800x748 and 463:4126 overruns it by the same 7px. On 66:4 (canvas 780, viewport ends 748) 463:4003 clears the frame but overruns the viewport by 7px. On the 812 canvases 715+40=755 sits inside the 780 viewport, which is the intended float.
fix: Bottom-anchor the toolbar (canvas height − 65) instead of pinning y=715, so it lands at 683 on the 748 canvases and 715 on the 812 ones.

finding: The Preview shell board draws a bare 1440 canvas with no device bar; the shipping preview has a 40px device toolbar at the top of that region, and it is preview's only device control.
evidence: 65:211 -> Middle band 65:230 -> Canvas 65:279 (1440x844) whose only child is viewport 65:291 (1440x812) holding site page 65:292 (1100x520). PreviewOverlay.tsx:38-40 sizes the region `fixed left-0 right-0 bottom-0 top-[var(--bk-size-topbar)]` (=1440x844 at 1440x900, matching the board) but :43-45 and :99-101 then render DEVICE_BAR_CLASS — 'tw:shrink-0 tw:h-10 … border-b' — containing a BreakpointSwitcher, citing board 807:8707. 807:8707 'device-toolbar' exists and is 1440x40 with device/Desktop 1440px, device/Tablet 768px, device/Mobile 375px. The shell board shows none of it.
fix: Add an instance of 807:8707 at the top of 65:279 and shorten the viewport to 1440x804 (844 − 40), or 772 if SH-E-09's dead 32 is also removed.

finding: The preview device toolbar the code is built from carries a 'Share preview' button that the code does not render and that the file marks not-implemented elsewhere.
evidence: 807:8707 -> 807:8717 'share-preview-btn' (110x28 at x=1300) with label 807:8718 'Share preview'. PreviewOverlay.tsx:99-114 renders only the BreakpointSwitcher in that bar plus the Done pill — there is no share control anywhere in the file. Section 14 marks the capability dead: 817:4774 '[not-implemented · superseded by 988:2 · Site · Access] Preview · share link'. 807:8707 carries no such marker, so anyone building the bar from it will build a button with no destination.
fix: Delete 807:8717/807:8718, or rename it with the same [not-implemented · superseded by 988:2] prefix 817:4774 uses.

finding: Preview's Done pill sits 44px above the bottom on the board and 20px in the code.
evidence: 65:211 -> 65:410 'Done pill' 110x36 at x=665 y=820 in a 900-tall frame — centred (665+55 = 720 = 1440/2) and 44px clear of the bottom. PreviewOverlay.tsx:65-68 DONE_CLASS = 'tw:absolute tw:bottom-5 … tw:h-9 tw:min-w-[110px] … rounded-full bg-[var(--bk-ink)]' — 20px, though the 36px height and 110px min-width match the board exactly.
fix: Either move 65:410 to y=844 or change `tw:bottom-5` to `tw:bottom-11`; the pill's other three dimensions already agree, so this is one number.

finding: No shell board draws any device but Desktop or any zoom but 100%, so the shell's arrangement at tablet/mobile and at any zoom is entirely undrawn even though both systems ship.
evidence: Every footer on every shell board reads 'Desktop · 100%' (65:200, 65:610, 66:202, 66:423, 66:639, 66:838, 199:200, 199:403, 199:607, 200:200, 200:411, 2162:11755, 2162:11933, 963:4697, 642:3935, 52:10's 53:23). Code ships five devices (`DeviceType = desktop|tablet|mobile|watch|wide`, shared/types/state.ts:34), the canvas toolbar exposes four (CanvasFooterToolbar.tsx:322 passes `includeWide` to BreakpointSwitcher, whose entries are W/D/T/M at BreakpointSwitcher.tsx:39-44), and eight zoom presets ship (`ZOOM_PRESETS = [10,25,50,75,100,150,200,400]`, shared/constants/canvas.ts:360). The boards even draw the four device chips inside the toolbar (463:3969-463:3975 chip/W chip/D chip/T chip/M) — the control is drawn, the state it produces never is.
fix: Add at least one Tablet board (768 page frame in the 800 canvas lane) and one non-100% zoom board so the canvas-frame arithmetic under a scaled page is settled somewhere.

finding: The zoom flyout board omits the 10% preset that its own caption promises and that the footer ships.
evidence: 817:4723's caption 817:4725 reads 'Range: 10%–400%', but the flyout 817:4726 lists seven presets only — 25% (817:4734), 50%, 75%, 100%, 150%, 200%, 400% (817:4742). StudioFooter.tsx:258 maps ZOOM_PRESETS, which is `[10, 25, 50, 75, 100, 150, 200, 400]` (shared/constants/canvas.ts:360, whose comment says '10 stays'). The live flyout therefore has eight rows where the board has seven.
fix: Add a 10% row above 817:4734 and grow 817:4726 by 26px.

finding: The status bar's only control is drawn as flat text on every board — no chevron, no border, no hover — while in code it is a menu button, and a separate board is the only place that says it is clickable.
evidence: The footer's own board 52:10 draws 53:23 'Desktop · 100%' as a bare TEXT node 81x16 at x=1343 y=8; all thirteen shell boards copy it verbatim (65:200, 199:200, 66:423, 2162:11755, …). Code renders it as a Button with `aria-haspopup="menu"`, `aria-expanded`, `data-testid="footer-device-zoom"` and a hover colour change (StudioFooter.tsx:226-237), opening the flyout at :238-282. The clickability is documented only on 817:4725 ('Click percentage to open flyout'), which is in section 09, not on the footer itself.
fix: Give 53:23 a control skin on 52:10 and propagate — a hover/idle chip with a ▾, matching the flyout's trigger — so the one action in the status bar is visibly an action.

finding: In read-only view mode the status bar keeps its 32px band and its live zoom button but has its entire left half blanked by CSS, and no board draws that footer.
evidence: Canvas.css:174-178 hides `[data-testid="footer-selection-label"]` and `[data-testid="footer-selection-dims"]` under `.bk-read-only-view`; `[data-testid="footer-device-zoom"]` is not in that list, so the zoom menu stays live. StudioPanels.tsx:205-208 records why the fix stopped there: 'the footer's selection label is rendered by AquibraStudio, which an agent session must not stage'. The result is a bordered 32px bar, empty from x=16 to x=1343, on the surface a client is shown.
fix: Board the view-mode footer, or hide the footer wholesale in view mode the way the rail, drawer and inspector already are (StudioPanels.tsx:427, 493).

finding: Preview hides the footer, rail, drawer and canvas by painting over them, so F6 still cycles keyboard focus into five regions the user cannot see.
evidence: Board 65:211 correctly draws no footer, rail, drawer or inspector. The code removes none of them: PreviewOverlay.tsx:38-40 is a `fixed` region from `top-[var(--bk-size-topbar)]` to `bottom-0` at z `Z_LAYERS.floatingPanel` painted over an untouched shell. regionCycle.ts:12-20 resolves its seven regions by live selector — `[role="banner"]`, `.ls-rail`, `.ls-panel:not(.ls-panel--closed)`, `[role="tablist"][aria-label="Site pages"]`, `#layout-canvas`, `.bdi-panel`, `[role="contentinfo"]` — and its visibility test is `el.offsetParent !== null` (regionCycle.ts:22-24), which an element covered by a fixed overlay still passes. The footer that AquibraStudio.tsx:711-712 gives `role="contentinfo"` is therefore still tab-reachable behind the preview, along with the zoom menu inside it.
fix: Have PreviewOverlay set `inert` (or aria-hidden + a regionCycle bail-out) on the shell root while it is mounted, so the drawn state and the focus order agree.

finding: The boards model the footer's empty size slot as a zero-width text node rather than an absent one — a literal zero-width region in the layout.
evidence: On 65:2 the footer holds 65:198 'Text' TEXT 0x16 at x=121 y=8, between the label 65:197 and the spacer 65:199; 65:412 repeats it as 65:608 (0x16 at x=83). Code renders nothing at all — StudioFooter.tsx:217-224 wraps the dims span in `{dims && (…)}`, and `elementDims` returns null when the node is absent or has no box (:79-87).
fix: Delete 65:198 and 65:608 and let the spacer start where the label ends; a 0x16 node is invisible in the board and misleads anyone measuring the row's gaps.

finding: The presence slot is drawn 1px wide on all thirteen shell boards — including the board whose whole subject is presence.
evidence: The Topbar instance on every board carries `presence` at 1x24 at x=1246: I682:2657;692:477 (65:2), I682:2687;692:474 (65:211), I682:4901;692:474 (199:2), I682:4926;692:474 (199:205), I682:2738;692:474 (66:4), and the same on 199:409, 200:2, 200:213, 66:225, 66:441, 66:640, 2162:11660, 2162:11838, 963:4474 — and on 642:3696 '[design-ahead] Shell state 13 · Presence (multiplayer)' itself. A 1px region between the spacer's end (x=1234) and btn/notifications (x=1259) reserves 25px of gap that nothing occupies.
fix: Give the Presence INSTANCE_SWAP default (692:421) a real avatar-stack width on 642:3696 at minimum, so the one board about presence shows the slot at the size presence needs. Flagged here because it is the only zero-width region in the shell; the topbar axis owns the component itself.

finding: Three shell boards draw the whole shell short of their own 1440x900 frame to clear prototype hotspot strips, so measuring the ENTRY POINT board gives a canvas 64px shorter than the code produces.
evidence: 65:2: Topbar 56 + Middle band 65:21 (1440x748) + Footer 65:196 (32, at y=804) = 836 in a 900 frame; the 64px remainder is occupied by 881:4519 and 881:4521, two 'hotspot/alt' strips at y=836 and y=868. 66:4: 56 + 66:23 (780) + 66:198 (32 at y=836) = 868, with 881:4524 at y=868. 66:640: 56 + 66:659 (748) + 66:834 (32 at y=804) = 836, with 881:4528 and 881:4530 at y=836 and y=868. The other nine live boards sum to exactly 900 (e.g. 199:2: 56 + 199:21 812 + 199:196 32) and park their hotspots ON TOP of the shell instead (199:2's 633:3993 at y=866, 1682:7237 at y=820).
fix: Restore Middle band to 812 on 65:2 and 66:640 and to 812 on 66:4, and overlay their hotspot strips the way 199:2 does. Canvas, inspector and drawer heights on those boards all move with it.

finding: The slot-proof board — the one board whose job is documenting the region contract — states a drawer slot width of 320, contradicting the 280 it draws and the 280 the token ships.
evidence: 963:4474 'Shell · 360 overlay panel (slot proof)' -> callout 963:4760 -> text 963:4761 'Drawer slot · 320 · pinned, pushes canvas'. The drawer it actually draws is 963:4497 'Drawer (pinned)' 280x812 at x=60, and its canvas 963:4524 is 800 wide, which only works at 280 (60+280+800+300 = 1440). Code is 280: tokens.generated.css:129 `--bk-size-drawer: 280px`, consumed by LayoutShell.css:26 and Drawer.tsx:33. 320 is the retired value LayoutShell.tsx:290-297 describes as the five-month overflow.
fix: Change 963:4761 to 'Drawer slot · 280 · pinned, pushes canvas'.

finding: The slot-proof board still wires a hotspot into the retired narrow-viewport board, whose code branch was deleted the same day it was retired.
evidence: 963:4705 'hotspot/state · Shell · 1280 · pin auto-released (' has one reaction whose destinationId is '202:2' — the board named 'Shell · 1280 · pin auto-released (overlay) — RETIRED 2026-09-04'. 52:2 carries the same edge at 444:2432. Code: LayoutShell.tsx:267-272 — 'The drawer-overlay ("pin auto-released") mode that used to hang off a `drawerPinned` prop here is retired (2026-09-04, board 202:2 renamed).'
fix: Delete 963:4705 and 444:2432, or repoint them once SH-E-08 settles what the shell actually does below 1366.

finding: F6 region cycling skips the inspector whenever nothing is selected — which is the state two shell boards draw as the default — leaving its Ask AI button unreachable by keyboard even though the 300px column is on screen.
evidence: regionCycle.ts:12-20 resolves region 6 as `.bdi-panel`. ProInspector.tsx applies that class only on the multi-select path (:301) and the selected path (:327); the no-selection path returns <InspectorEmptyState/> (:320), whose container is `CONTAINER = ${CONTAINER_BASE} tw:pt-16` with no `bdi-panel` (InspectorEmptyState.tsx:120-127) and which contains a live Button, `inspector-empty-ask-ai` (:85-91). InspectorLoading.tsx:32 does carry `bdi-panel`, so loading stays in the cycle and the far more common empty state does not. The column itself is open regardless — StudioPanels.tsx:421-424 deliberately does not gate `inspectorOpen` on selection.
fix: Add `bdi-panel` to InspectorEmptyState's CONTAINER (and CONTAINER_APPLIED) so the visible region is in the cycle; regionCycle.ts:18's 'drops out with no selection' comment then needs correcting too.
